title: MPRG Summer exhibitions launch
summary: Join Mornington Peninsula Regional Gallery for the launch of two summer exhibitions on Saturday 5 December. Acting director Julie McLaren introduces work by Gareth Sansom and Warren Cooke from 2pm to 4pm.
description: Mornington Peninsula Regional Gallery opens its summer program with a two-hour launch for Gareth Sansom: Muses & Mischief and Warren Cooke: Swirling Myth / Fluid Lore. Acting director Julie McLaren will introduce the exhibitions.

editorNote:
Mornington Peninsula Regional Gallery lists a launch for its two summer exhibitions on Saturday 5 December, from 2pm to 4pm. Acting director Julie McLaren is named as the person introducing Gareth Sansom: Muses & Mischief and Warren Cooke: Swirling Myth / Fluid Lore. This listing is for the opening event only; the exhibitions themselves have a longer run.

The organiser's Eventbrite page gives the gallery address as 350 Dunns Road, Mornington. Follow that page for registration details and any updates to the program before travelling. We have not checked remaining places, so the presence of a registration page should not be read as a promise that a place is available.

The gallery's event listing does not spell out event-specific accessibility or weather arrangements. Contact MPRG if you need to confirm step-free access or other accommodations. The picture frames shown here are a Peninsula Insider illustration, not photographs of the exhibitions or artwork by either artist. The organiser's event page was checked on 21 November 2026.
